changes_made: STRUCTURE: rebuilt from 25 to 30 beats and 3 chapters (One place to look, A detailed eye, Control). The old chapter 'Never falsely safe' is gone (lead decision 5, no blanket claim); the doubt moments now sit inside 'A detailed eye'. Chapters 2 and 3 are product by product so same-image beats glide as one scene.
h01 rewritten: opens on the human question, then 'Heat has an answer. Lightning has one. So does gas. You need one place to look.' Last card line is now 'One place to look.'
u01 reworded to 'one umbrella over weather, lightning and gas, on one site' (scoped to the three products); tagline set to 'weather, lightning and gas, in one place'.
u02 kept as the three-product stage; Lightning card subtitle changed to 'State and alarm history'; narration now says each product has its own screens and devices.
u03 kept, chips unchanged (one backend, one menu and header, same view permission, switched on per project); no 'one rule set', 'one audit trail' or 'one permission for everything'.

u04 kept on umbrella stage 6 but moved before the screens and the verb changed from 'Set limits' to 'Watch, Decide, Control'; the voice scopes 'control' in k01, k02, k03 (decision 6). Reason: the builder cannot replay the umbrella stages later in a second scene.

o01 reworded to 'New: Connected Products lists what each project has switched on, and the menu follows' (fixes the 'decides which products' implication); tri crops enlarged to 700x350 so the Active and Inactive text is bigger and the title is not cut.

o02 kept (gas status line in the shared header, recaptured u-ws-c); narration no longer quotes detector counts; the camera window excludes the Stations card, so the green 'Last reading' line is not in the settled shot (decision 4).

o03 kept as the cross-product tri but crops re-measured for the current frames (lightning ends at frame y 570 above the moved Held for box at y 580); gas crop now includes the header 'Gas CHECK' so the green gas cards are not read as 'all fine'; narration says what each page reads: Danger, All Clear, Check.
c01 is the old answer-strip beat on the drawer frame, cut to 13 words (fixes the 18-word sentence); callouts re-checked; no station list or green line is on screen because the drawer covers them.

c02 NEW (replaces s01): weather offline station flagged by number, readiness Not ready; camera window ends at frame y 590, above the green line at y 606; names are blurred and never narrated. Answers 'named means serial' and the absolute-claim findings.
w03 NEW: gear dialog (new weather feature) with a spotlight that ends above the rows that list gas parameters; narration 'a gear picks which readings the dashboard features'.
c03 reworked from a tri to a shot with two callouts on the peak heat index and peak wind speed cards (the station names are blurred now); no figures narrated; no black half-screen.

l01 NEW (replaces s03): states 'only green counts as safe to work' as a product rule, not page text (fixes the misattribution), plus the page's backup banner and 'cabinet lights and sounder first'; settled window ends at frame y 564 above Held for. Held for is never narrated or targeted.

l02 NEW: Lightning radii map (new Esri satellite map, blurred, caption says blurred), narration 'rings are reference only, not a live strike position'; imagery never described; the radii are not claimed to change the alarm.

l03 NEW: Lightning alarm history and alarm activity chart using l-hist-b copied from the lightning folder (same refreshed capture); window excludes the Held for box; Export CSV (disabled) not mentioned.

g01 NEW (replaces s01 gas half): Gas Check and 'Not confirmed safe' from g-mobile-desktopview-c copied from the gas folder (the umbrella's own u-gas-c frame does not carry that sentence); narration 'The page does not guess: it says Check, Not confirmed safe'.

g02 reworded: callout 'Each against its limit' became 'Worst reading per gas' and the narration says 'worst current reading' (oxygen low limit is 'not alarmed yet', decision 8); refreshed u-gas-c numbers are not narrated.
g03 NEW: Gas Compliance, 'Limits in force' plus the two 'Not available yet' panels; shows honestly that not everything lands in the platform.

k01 reworded: 'Control is specific. In weather, limits decide when work stops. New: a thirty day preview of what a limit would have done.' Callout label 'Stopped on 8' replaced by 'What-if, last 30 days' (fixes the dropped 'would have'); no band numbers narrated, spotlighted or labelled (decision 3).

k02 NEW: Settings > Lightning (refreshed frame): alert distances and the sensor location marked Temporary; 'Each product has its own settings'; camera window starts at frame y 213 so the radii intro line is out of the settled shot; the 'Set manually until...' note is not spotlighted or read; no claim that the distances change the alarm.

k03 reworked on the refreshed Gas Alerts frame: 'With edit access, you can close an alert here. The page says it is not sent to Blackline, the vendor: it stays open in Blackline Live.' Callouts on the page note and a click demonstration on a Close button; Blackline is glossed as the vendor (cross-video wording finding); who or when the three Closed rows were closed is not narrated.

p02 fixed: 'Same mesh, same frames' became 'same mesh' and lane text 'same kind of frames'; step text 'unreadable: set aside'.
p03 trimmed to vendor cloud, black box, no mesh, no Modbus; lane 3 step titles shortened ('Detectors send / about every 30 min') so they no longer wrap.
p04 kept as a short sink beat ('Different roads in. One platform behind them.').

a01 reworded to drop 'Everything lands' and 'one day': 'One platform holds readings and status from all three, a base for a future AI assistant.' Diagram column now lists 'Weather readings and limits', 'Lightning status', 'Gas readings and alerts' (no 'Alerts and history').

MOOT after refresh and decisions: the open question whether Gas acknowledge and close is deployed (answered by the changed rows); station-name masking (names are blurred, never narrated); 'Never falsely safe' chapter and the blanket-claim wording (decision 5); the Esri map being 'not live' (it is live and blurred).

Brief coverage: (a) umbrella u01 to u03; (b) watch, detailed eye, control u04, c01 to g03, k01 to k03; (c) AI direction a01 to a04, with Gas history and some gas figures shown as Not available yet in g03; (d) paths p01 to p04 with Modbus explained; (e) every listed new screen has its own beat.
open_issues: LENGTH: 497 words, 218 s (3:38) in the dry render, about 8 s over the 3:30 target; it is within the 520 word range. The brief's word and time targets conflict (520 words is about 3:46). Cut order if the real voice runs long: g03, then w03, then l03, then p04.
Under the 15 word floor: u02, u04, o01, o02, c01, w03, l02, l03, g03, p04 (10 beats). They are stage reveals or one-glance new-screen beats; lengthening them would push the video further over 3:30.

BUILDER (vbuild.py, not edited): a shot scene always starts at the full frame and glides in about 1 s, so the Held for box (Lightning, l01 and the l01 to l02 glide) and the green 'Last reading was N minute(s) ago.' line (c02) are legible for roughly 1 s. Accepted under decisions 2 and 4; do not pick a thumbnail from the first second of l01 or c02. A 'start at the zoom pose' option would remove it.

BUILDER: the chapter bar prints 'CLICK <path>' on every chaptered shot, including shots where nothing is clicked (carried from the first fact-check). The chapter paths are written as menu paths so it reads as 'where to find it'; only k03 and z01 have click callouts. A 'WHERE' label or no prefix unless click:true would be cleaner.

BUILDER: the umbrella stage 6 connector always points at the Weather Station card, and the lower third of the umbrella scene (stages 4, 5, 7 skipped on purpose) is empty; tri tiles fill only the top 40 to 45 percent of the stage; labels with pos l or inr drift on zoomed shots, so I used a, b and r.
Lead check: the verb 'Control' on the umbrella team card follows your brief; the narration scopes it in k01 to k03. If you want to be stricter, change the verbs to Watch, Decide, Act.

Frames borrowed from other folders (copied unchanged): g-mobile-desktopview-c.png from gas (g01, the only umbrella-ready frame with 'Not confirmed safe') and l-hist-b.png from lightning (l03). Both are refreshed 1.0.7 captures. Both folders must keep them if the umbrella assets are ever resynced.

Gas Compliance (g03) shows per-gas SAFE badges in its table next to the page-level Check; they are on screen but not narrated or spotlighted. If you prefer none, narrow the g03 zoom to the two Not available yet panels (frame y 427 to 643).

Gear dialog (w03): the dialog also lists CO2, H2S and CO weather parameters lower down; the spotlight and camera window end above them. Lightning wallboard and phone views and the Gas Detectors page are not featured (no umbrella frame, or cut for length).
Frame values drift: u-gas-c says Last reading 17 min ago while the u-ws-c header says 20 min ago and the Gas Alerts and Compliance frames 17 and 18 min; the numbers are never narrated, only 'Check'.
assumptions: Chips and 'Control' scope follow the lead's decisions: one backend, one menu and header, same view permission, switched on per project; control is weather limits with the 30 day what-if preview, Lightning alert distances and a Temporary sensor location, and Gas alerts recorded in WakeCap only.

'New' is used only where changes.json says live_in_1_0_5 yes and a frame shows it (Connected Products, gas status line, gear dialog, Maximum Values Report, radii map, alarm history, Gas Overview, Compliance limits, 30 day preview).
Project A, B and C are three different projects, labelled only by those letters; no beat presents them as one site.

Gas cadence ('about every minute' for WakeCap, 'about every 30 min' for detectors) appears in lane text only (G03 live_today unknown); the narration says only vendor cloud, black box, no mesh, no Modbus.
'Check' and 'Not confirmed safe' are quoted as page words; no beat says a site is safe. The lightning 'only green counts' line is stated as a product rule (L05, live_today yes), not as page text.
No clock time, date or station name is narrated, so the Saudi time question and the blurred names do not arise.
The real voice may run slower or faster than 2.35 words per second; the beatsheet lists the cut order.

findings.issue: Narration 'One that stops reporting reads Check, like the fifth.' (and sink 'Stopped reporting: Check') gives no time condition. The product marks a detector Check only when its newest reading is older than 60 minutes, or it is offline.
